description: Educational security baseline used to evaluate synthetic Windows workstation configuration settings.

controls.name: Minimum Password Length
controls.remediation: Configure the minimum password length to at least 14 characters.

controls.name: Password Complexity
controls.remediation: Enable password complexity requirements through the applicable security policy.

controls.name: Account Lockout Threshold
controls.remediation: Configure account lockout to trigger after no more than five invalid authentication attempts while avoiding a value of zero.

controls.name: Guest Account Disabled
controls.remediation: Disable the built-in Guest account unless a documented business requirement exists.

controls.name: Domain Firewall Enabled
controls.remediation: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the Domain profile.

controls.name: Private Firewall Enabled
controls.remediation: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the Private profile.

controls.name: Public Firewall Enabled
controls.remediation: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the Public profile.

controls.name: Remote Desktop Exposure Review
controls.remediation: Confirm that Remote Desktop is required. If it is not needed, disable it. If required, restrict access and apply strong authentication controls.

controls.name: Remote Desktop Network Level Authentication
controls.remediation: Enable Network Level Authentication whenever Remote Desktop is enabled.

controls.name: SMBv1 Disabled
controls.remediation: Disable SMBv1 and use supported SMB protocol versions.

controls.name: PowerShell Script Block Logging
controls.remediation: Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging to improve visibility into PowerShell activity.

controls.name: Process Creation Auditing
controls.remediation: Enable process creation auditing to improve endpoint investigation and detection capabilities.

controls.name: Automatic Security Updates
controls.remediation: Enable automatic security updates or manage the system through an approved centralized patch-management process.

controls.name: Endpoint Protection Enabled
controls.remediation: Enable approved endpoint protection and ensure protection services remain active.

controls.name: Local Administrator Count
controls.remediation: Review local administrator membership and reduce privileged accounts to the minimum required for business operations.
